value.statement: On β one has xβ_0=0, xβ_i=bar(λ-i+1)β_{i-1} for 1≤i≤λ; yβ_i=bar(i+1)β_{i+1} for 0≤i<λ; yβ_λ=0; hβ_i=bar(λ-2i)β_i for i∈I. For all r≥0, X_rβ_i=bar(binom(λ-i+r,r))β_{i-r} for r≤i and is zero for r>i; Y_rβ_i=bar(binom(i+r,r))β_{i+r} for i+r≤λ and is zero otherwise. For 0≤r≤λ the scalar bar(r!) is nonzero and X_r=bar(r!)^{-1}x^r, Y_r=bar(r!)^{-1}y^r on V(K).
